signed_intent_branch_gaps.unresolved: Local exact-runtime tests now cover invalid and tampered withdrawal signatures, a valid synthetic withdrawal, replay rejection, deadlines, and nonce rollback. All 103 sampled withdrawal nonce bits are checked before and after their blocks, and at the pin. Per-transaction storage diffs, unsampled withdrawals, and other signature encodings remain open.

Local tests cover invalid signatures, nonce and deadline failures, a four-ID close over empty slots with fourth-ID tampering, and a constructed four-active-position close cloned from one historical template. A full historical transaction replay matches two distinct signed closes. Two same-market and two cross-market four-ID gain/loss orders now reconcile balance, fees, locked margin, events, and nonce on exact runtime; all 16 library outputs in eight cross-market PnL and settlement call pairs match independent integer models and their close events. All 43 sampled close nonce bits persisted across their blocks and at the pin. Other rate, liquidity, queue, and margin boundaries plus historical session-key storage for every signer remain open.

Synthetic local tests cover invalid open signatures, nonce and deadline failures, and a valid session-key signature reaching raw 0x0a4f5a07 in constructed state. One successful historical open replays from archived prestate with logs and storage writes matched. Eight one-field changes to that signed calldata reject with 0xc5045f22, no logs, and no nonce consumption; replay in the next block rejects with 0x756688fe. Archive storage confirms 30 successful open nonce bits persisted and 28 rejected open bits stayed unset, including 27 nested nonce calls rolled back by their parent. A separate local control copies the original signer authorization to the changed user and confirms the changed digest recovers a different signer; the call still rejects. This copied key is a storage override, not a historical registration. Other open business-rule branches and signature encodings remain open.
